findings.title: SageMaker notebook not in custom VPC
findings.description: A SageMaker notebook instance without subnet_id runs outside a customer VPC, so its traffic and data access are not governed by VPC network controls.

evidence.expected: subnet_id set to a VPC subnet

findings.remediation: Review the flagged configuration against AWS security best practices and the CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark. Apply the control the rule describes, preferring restrictive defaults, encryption, and audit logging. Validate with `aegis scan` after the change.

findings.title: SageMaker notebook instance with root access enabled
findings.description: A SageMaker notebook instance with root_access enabled (the provider default) lets users log in as root, bypassing the notebook execution role's least-privilege boundary. Set root_access = "Disabled" unless root shell access is required.
findings.remediation: Enable MFA on the account and restrict root usage. Create individual IAM users or federate via SSO, attach least-privilege policies, and never use root for daily operations.
